title: Tripadvisor Location
description: A Tripadvisor location representing a hotel, restaurant, or attraction with comprehensive details including address, rating, reviews, and photos.

location_id.description: The unique Tripadvisor identifier for this location.

name.description: The display name of the location.

description.description: A detailed text description of the location.

web_url.description: The URL of the location's page on Tripadvisor.

ancestors.description: Array of parent geographic locations in the hierarchy.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the location.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the location.

timezone.description: The timezone of the location (e.g., America/New_York).

phone.description: The phone number of the location.

website.description: The official website URL of the location.

rating.description: The overall rating on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0.

rating_image_url.description: URL of the rating bubble image.

num_reviews.description: The total number of reviews for this location.

review_rating_count.description: Breakdown of review counts by rating level (1-5).

photo_count.description: The total number of photos available for this location.

subcategory.description: Array of subcategory classifications for this location.

cuisine.description: Array of cuisine types for restaurant locations.

groups.description: Array of category groups this location belongs to.

trip_types.description: Array of trip type ratings for this location.

awards.description: Array of awards received by this location.

Address.description: The physical address of a location.

address_string.description: The full formatted address as a single string.

Ancestor.description: A parent geographic location in the location hierarchy.

level.description: The level in the geographic hierarchy (e.g., City, Region, Country).

name.description: The name of the ancestor location.

location_id.description: The Tripadvisor location ID of the ancestor.

RankingData.description: Ranking information for the location within its category and geography.

geo_location_id.description: The Tripadvisor ID of the geographic area for ranking.

geo_location_name.description: The name of the geographic area for ranking.

ranking_out_of.description: The total number of locations in the ranking category.

name.description: The display name of the tag.

localized_name.description: The localized display name of the tag.

Group.description: A category group with associated sub-categories.

localized_name.description: The localized name of the group.

categories.description: Array of category tags within this group.

TripType.description: Rating data for a specific type of trip.

name.description: The trip type name (e.g., business, couples, family).

value.description: The count of reviews for this trip type.

Award.description: An award or recognition received by the location.

year.description: The year the award was given.

images.description: Image URLs for the award badge.

small.description: URL for the small award image.

large.description: URL for the large award image.

display_name.description: The display name of the award.

Hours.description: Operating hours information for the location.

periods.description: Array of time periods when the location is open.

day.description: Day of the week (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday).
Day of the week (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday).

weekday_text.description: Array of human-readable strings describing hours for each day.
